units.source_text: “这样的日子里连音色都不一样啊！”

en.t: Even the tone sounds different on a day like this!

units.source_text: 驹子仰头望了望雪后的晴空，只说了这么一句。

en.t: Komako tilted her head up and looked at the clear sky after the snow, and said only that.

units.source_text: 的确，那是由于天气不同。

en.t: Indeed, it was because the weather was different.

units.source_text: 要是没有剧场的墙壁，没有听众，也没有都市的尘埃，琴声就会透过冬日澄澈的晨空，畅通无阻地响澈远方积雪的群山。

en.t: Without the walls of a theater, without an audience, and without the dust of the city, the music would pass through the clear winter morning sky and ring out unhindered toward the distant snow-covered mountains.
